trial_backend.description: Probe Tailscale CLI availability without changing tailnet or serve state.

install_backend.description: macOS: install the Tailscale app through Homebrew (cask tailscale-app, macOS only), open it and log in. Kyberion uses the CLI inside the app bundle automatically; Settings > Install CLI is optional.

win32.description: Windows: install Tailscale through WinGet, then log in from the tray app or `tailscale up`.

linux.description: Linux: no unattended install — tailscaled is a root system service. Install from the upstream package repository (https://tailscale.com/download/linux), then `sudo tailscale up` and `sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER` so Kyberion can manage Funnel without root. This backend only re-checks the CLI.

tools.notes: Runtime for the public-ingress provider `tailscale-funnel`. macOS: the resolver finds /usr/local/bin/tailscale, /opt/homebrew/bin/tailscale or the app-bundle binary (/Applications/Tailscale.app/Contents/MacOS/Tailscale) on its own. Override with KYBERION_TAILSCALE_BIN.
